    Climb the Leaderboard

    Wager under code JAMMMY, climb the ranks and win a share of the prize pool. Updated live.

    ?How points work

    Power.win ranks this leaderboard by points, not dollars. Games where the house keeps less (higher RTP) earn fewer points per dollar, so every game is fair to climb with:

    Points = Bet × (100% − RTP) ÷ 4%never more than 1 point per $1 bet

    Blackjack 99.6% RTP$100 bet = 10 pts
    Roulette 97.3% RTP$100 bet = 67.5 pts
    Power.win Originals 99% RTP$100 bet = 25 pts
    Slots 96% RTP or lower$100 bet = 100 pts

    For the Community Vault, 1 point counts as $1 wagered.

    Every coin you wager in Jammmy Games counts, weighted by the multiplier you play for. Safe, low-multiplier play counts less, so nobody can farm the board.

    Mines and HiLo at 2× or more100% counts
    Mines and HiLo at 1.5× to 2×50% counts
    Mines and HiLo under 1.5×25% counts
    Plinko high / medium / low risk100% / 50% / 25%
    Blackjack main bet / side bets50% / 100%

    Mines and HiLo: the multiplier you cash out at, or the one your last pick was going for. Example: 100 coins on Mines cashed out at 3.2× counts 100; at 1.2× it counts 25.

    📜 Leaderboard terms & conditions＋
    1. Who can take part. Only wagers on Power.win made under code JAMMMY during the race count. You must be 18 or older and allowed to gamble where you live.
    2. One account per person. Using more than one account, or playing on someone else's, gets every account involved disqualified.
    3. Wager abuse. If we find wager abuse, we hold every right to reject or withhold the rewards. This includes, but isn't limited to: bets placed only to farm wager with almost no risk, betting both sides or hedging between accounts, working with other players, bots or scripts, and exploiting bugs or promotions. Decisions are made by the Jammmy team and are final.
    4. Claiming your prize. Prizes are not sent automatically. Winners must open a ticket in our Discord within 7 days of the race ending, with their Power.win username and finishing place. Prizes not claimed within 7 days are void.
    5. Proving it's you. We may ask you to show that the Power.win account is yours, for example a screenshot while logged in. If you play with a hidden (incognito) name, you must be able to prove which account is yours to be paid.
    6. Final standings. The final places come from Power.win's own figures when the race ends. The live board on this page is for guidance and can be a few minutes behind.
    7. Changes. We can change, pause or end the leaderboard, its prizes or these terms at any time. Power.win's own terms apply to all play on Power.win.
    8. Play responsibly. Only gamble what you can afford to lose. If gambling stops being fun, take a break and reach out for support.

    Questions

    Do I need to link a casino to earn coins?

    No. Daily claims, Kick, Discord, games and challenges work with just your Discord login. Linking a casino adds the vault, leaderboard prizes and partner wager for ranks.

    Why is my claim still pending?

    An admin checks every casino account against your Discord to stop alt accounts. It's usually quick; you'll see it switch to Approved on your Profile.

    Can I have more than one account?

    No. Accounts that share devices or networks get flagged and can lose their rewards.

    How often do ranks update?

    About every 10 minutes, and right away whenever you open the Ranks page.
